title: subscription/link & subscription/unlink
description: Linking a named subscription of a catalog agent (vincular-suscripciones): the daemon writes a launch profile whose env pins the provider's auth-context variable to a fresh, empty directory, and answers with the composed login gesture it never runs — the official binary authenticates itself, and Meltemi neither reads nor deletes what it stores (fair play). Unlinking removes the profile from the daemon-owned store only; hand-written profiles refuse with a remedy, and the context directory is always left behind, named.

agent.description: Catalog id of the agent the subscription runs. The entry must declare its auth-context variable in the registry snapshot.

name.description: Link name: becomes the profile name and the context directory's name, so it is a safe kebab-case path component.

contextDir.description: The auth-context directory left behind, untouched: whatever the provider stored there is not Meltemi's to destroy.
